metadata.title: SpotThisFit | Find & Shop Any Outfit from Photos, TikTok, Instagram & YouTube
metadata.description: AI-powered fashion finder that identifies clothing in photos and social videos and shows where to buy it. Upload a photo or paste a video link to shop instantly.
landing.hero.subheading: AI-Powered Fashion Finder for Photos & Social Media
landing.hero.subtitle: See an outfit you love on TikTok or Instagram? Or have a photo of a look you want? SpotThisFit uses AI to identify every piece of clothing and shows you exactly where to buy it.
landing.cta.supporting: Upload a photo or use a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Facebook video

landing.howItWorks.step1.title: Upload a photo or paste a video link
landing.howItWorks.step1.description: Upload any photo or screenshot, or paste a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or Facebook video link.
landing.howItWorks.step2.title: AI identifies every item
landing.howItWorks.step2.description: Our visual AI spots clothing items and accessories in seconds.
landing.howItWorks.step3.title: Shop instantly
landing.howItWorks.step3.description: Get direct links to buy the exact items or affordable alternatives.
landing.problem.title: Stop Losing Track of Outfits You Love
landing.problem.item1: Saved a screenshot of an outfit but can't find it anywhere? Upload it and we'll match it.
landing.problem.item2: Can't find that viral TikTok outfit? Paste the link or upload a screenshot — we'll find it.
landing.problem.item3: Want affordable alternatives to expensive fits? We find dupes from any photo or video.
